warnings: This sheet is the spec source for footing marks F1, F2, F3 and F4 and for slab marks S0 and S1. Both buildings use it: F1/F2 belong to the main building (per S-01) and F3/F4 to the toilet block, so this file carries building null and is joined by element_id, not by grid.

F1 and F3 share ONE detail drawing, printed as 'F1,F3'. They are therefore identical in size and reinforcement despite being used on different buildings (F1 = main building row ข, F3 = toilet block rows ค/ก). The element_id is kept exactly as printed ('F1,F3') per spec §8 -- do not silently split it into two entries, and do not assume either mark has its own separate detail elsewhere.

UNCERTAIN -- top/bottom face assignment on F2 and F4. Their sections print two bar callouts on a stacked pair of leaders ('7 ø12 มม.' above '5 ø15 มม.') without an explicit บน/ล่าง label. Per spec §7 the leader line, not the label order, decides the face -- at the available scan resolution the two leaders could not be traced to distinct bar rows with confidence. They are recorded as bottom = 7ø12 and top = 5ø15 with flag rebar_face_assignment_uncertain and confidence 0.78. Note this is the opposite pattern from F1/F3, which prints a single combined two-way mat ('5+5 ø12 มม. #'), so it cannot be resolved by analogy either. VERIFY against a higher-resolution scan before this is used as ground truth.

All three footing details are drawn 'แบบตอกเข็ม' (pile type) only. The spread-footing alternative that S-01's legend and รายการประกอบแบบ 4.1 refer to has NO detail drawing anywhere in this sheet -- so pile counts (F1/F3 = 4, F2 = 6, F4 = 8, each 0.15x0.15 hollow hexagonal, 6.00 m, 1.7 t safe load) apply to the pile option only.

Pile counts were verified by counting the '+' pile symbols on each plan view at high magnification and cross-checking against the printed 'จำนวน N ต้น' note on each section: F1/F3 4 piles (2x2), F2 6 piles (3x2), F4 8 piles (4 corners + 4 edge midpoints). Both readings agree for all three.

The S1 detail's 2.25 + 2.25 spans corroborate (but do not dimension) the two dummy grid lines ค'/ข' added to the toilet block's grid master -- see หน้า00b_gridline_สุขา.json. S-04 gives no grid ref for these spans.

'คอม้า' in the S1 callouts means a bent-up (cranked) bar; 'ตรง 1 คอม้า 1' means straight and bent-up bars alternate one-for-one. Recorded verbatim in the note rather than normalised, since the schema has no bent-bar field.
NORMALIZED_2026-08-02: a packed size string (e.g. "0.20x0.40") was replaced by numeric width_mm/height_mm per schema 0.5; the printed text is kept in the matching *_printed_as field.
